package.description: Navicat Premium Lite is a compact version of Navicat, packed with the core features needed for users who primarily need to perform basic database operations.

en-US.description: Navicat Premium Lite is a compact version of Navicat, packed with the core features needed for users who primarily need to perform basic database operations.
en-US.longDescription: Navicat Premium Lite is a compact version of Navicat, packed with the core features needed for users who primarily need to perform basic database operations. It allows you to simultaneously connect to a variety of database platforms, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MariaDB, Snowflake, as well as NoSQL databases like Redis and MongoDB, all from a single application. Additionally, Navicat Premium Lite is compatible with GaussDB, OceanBase and PolarDB database platforms.
en-US.name: Navicat Premium Lite
